snippet.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: SHOWTIME - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The release trailer for my fan game 'FNaF: SHOWTIME'.

The game can be found on itch.io and GameJolt. Still can't link stuff, but you should be able to find it just by searching for 'FNaF: SHOWTIME' on either sites.
